info.name: T6.4 新旧会话范围核验（仅18080只读）

exec: function check(n,ok){pm.test(n,function(){pm.expect(Boolean(ok)).to.equal(true);});}var b=pm.response.json();check('HTTP 200',pm.response.code===200);check('Business 200',b.code===200);var shape=Array.isArray(b.rows)&&Number.isInteger(b.total);check('Shape',shape);if(!shape||pm.response.code!==200||b.code!==200){postman.setNextRequest(null);throw new Error('Structural response failed');}var ex=JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('expectedRows'));var pg=Number(pm.environment.get('oldAPage'));var ids=b.rows.map(u=>u.userId);check('Total follows new department',b.total===ex.length);check('Ordered page IDs follow new department',JSON.stringify(ids)===JSON.stringify(ex.slice(pg-1,pg).map(u=>u.user_id)));check('Every row belongs to new department',b.rows.every(u=>u.deptId===201));var all=JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('oldAIds'));all.push(...ids);pm.environment.set('oldAIds',JSON.stringify(all));if(pg<b.total){pm.environment.set('oldAPage',pg+1);postman.setNextRequest(pm.info.requestName);}else{check('Complete ID set follows new department',JSON.stringify(all)===JSON.stringify(ex.map(u=>u.user_id)));check('No duplicate IDs',new Set(all).size===all.length);}console.log('T64_EVENT '+JSON.stringify({session:'oldA',page:pg,total:b.total,ids:ids,deptIds:b.rows.map(u=>u.deptId),code:b.code}));
